meta.title_plain: How Diary of a Wimpy Kid went from a website to 300 million books
meta.teaser: Jeff Kinney's cartoonist dream flopped, so he built Greg Heffley instead.

page.title: How a comic on a kids' website became 300 million books
page.sub: The story of Jeff Kinney and Diary of a Wimpy Kid
page.bigIdea: Jeff Kinney's first dream didn't work out. So he kept drawing and built something new from it.

cards.title: A kid who loved comics
cards.front: Jeff Kinney was born in 1971 in Maryland, USA.
cards.back: As a kid he wanted to be a cartoonist. In college he drew a comic called Igdoof for the student newspaper.
cards.tryit: Draw a 3-panel comic about something funny from your week.

cards.title: The dream that didn't work
cards.front: After college, he tried to become a newspaper cartoonist.
cards.back: It didn't work out. So he got normal jobs, including designing online games for kids. He still kept drawing.
cards.tryit: Think of one loss that taught you something. Write it down.

cards.title: Eight years of quiet work
cards.front: In 1998 he started sketching ideas for Greg Heffley.
cards.back: He worked on it for almost eight years before showing a publisher. Like a long rally, he kept the point going.
cards.tryit: Pick one skill and practice it 10 minutes every day this week.

cards.title: Online before it was a book
cards.front: In 2004 the story first appeared on a kids' website, Funbrain.
cards.back: He posted a new bit each day. About 70,000 people visited daily, like a hit Roblox game everyone shares.
cards.tryit: Ask a friend: what makes you come back to a game every day?

cards.title: A slow start, then huge
cards.front: The first book came out in 2007.
cards.back: Sales started slowly, then kids told friends. By 2025, over 300 million copies sold, in 50+ languages.
cards.tryit: Recommend one book or show you love to a friend today.

words.d: An artist who draws comics or funny pictures that tell a story.

quiz.q: What did Jeff Kinney want to be as a kid?
quiz.hint: Think about what he drew in college.
quiz.why: He dreamed of drawing comics, and he drew Igdoof in college.

quiz.q: Where did Diary of a Wimpy Kid first appear?
quiz.hint: Check idea 4. It was before the book.
quiz.why: It started on Funbrain in 2004, with a new part posted each day.

quiz.q: How did the first book become a hit?
opts: It was famous on day one
Kids told their friends about it
quiz.hint: Look at the words to know.
quiz.why: Sales started slowly, then word of mouth made it grow and grow.

quiz.q: What did Jeff do when his first dream didn't work out?
opts: He kept drawing and made something new
quiz.hint: Read the big idea at the top.
quiz.why: He kept drawing for years, and that work became Greg Heffley.

page.think: Jeff spent almost eight years on Greg before anyone saw him. What's something you'd be willing to work on for a long time, and why?
